description:
Delete the repository named 'helix-staging-local' from JFrog Artifactory using the web UI. This repository contains outdated staging artifacts from a completed project and needs to be decommissioned. 

1. Log in to Artifactory at http://localhost:8082 (Username: 'admin', Password: 'password').
2. Navigate to the Administration panel.
3. Locate 'helix-staging-local' in the repository list.
4. Delete the repository and confirm the action.
5. Verify it is removed from the list.
